description: Paid live re-probe of up to 10 hosts. Args domains (string array) and mode "full". Unpaid calls return one HTTP 402. Price is $0.01 + $0.002 × N USDC on Base.

domains.description: Hostnames to re-probe. Length 1 to 10. Each item is normalized like domain; duplicates collapse after normalize. Empty after normalize is rejected.

items.description: Public hostname without a scheme. A scheme, port, path, and leading www. are stripped if present. After normalize: two or more DNS labels, each [a-z0-9] with optional interior hyphens (max 63 chars), total length at most 253. Empty input, literal IPs, and bare labels are rejected.

name: refresh_hosts_batch
